description.value:
You replace your eyes with vat-grown visual organs modeled after the completely white eyes of calignis. The eyes absorb light that's released in a blinding flash in response to trauma.

Activate—Final Flash f (light)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You gain the dying condition or are killed instantly

Effect All creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:19|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded|traits:light] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}; on a critical failure, they're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded] for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} instead.
